blocking_findings.summary: The public raw consumer-view constructor could forge comparison, release, accounting, and terminal views from bare digests.
Legacy sealed authority slot fields were writable after construction.
The successor package-terminal builder did not validate the complete legacy package terminal or accounting continuity.
Bundle binding accepted an arbitrary result-PASS mapping without exact schema, role, package, event, and hash continuity.

unresolved_findings: package-terminal transition-chain and V11 closure inputs remained bare digests
primary terminal binding accepted a raw bundle and bare binding digest
the pure terminal builder could create multiple documents for one package identity
